messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — two interviewer kits missing candidate accommodation flags today (e.g., requires_live_caption). Scheduling got blocked. cc @sam @jules
sam: Yikes. Is this the export or our mapper?
emma: Raw webhook shows flags, CSV export has header but blanks. Old CSV:
```
candidate_id,accessibility_flags
55501,requires_live_caption;low_vision
```
New CSV:
```
candidate_id,accessibility_flags
55501,
```
jules: Sounds like the recent metadata->flat refactor dropped arrays. I'll triage the mapping lambda.
alina: Could impact scorecard UI too if we don't show accommodations. Add to interviewer checklist in the meantime?
sam: Steps: 1) backfill current scheduled candidates, 2) patch mapper + unit tests, 3) add e2e check + alert, 4) training note.
jules: I'll run a one-off backfill from raw webhooks to populate interviewer_kits.accessibility_flags and scorecard.metadata.accessibility. Kicking off now.
infra-bot: backfill_accommodations job queued by jules — id bf-2149994321
jules: Batch 1 done (400 processed). Found 8 missing flags, updated records. No errors. Continuing.
emma: Thanks. I'll post a blurb to #new-interviewers asking folks to verify the accommodations field in kits this week.
alina: I'll add a short checkbox to the interviewer readiness doc and include a screenshot.
sam: After patch, run a sample audit of 200 flagged candidates. If green, we file a brief postmortem and close.
jules: Mapper PR opened with unit tests for array->semicolon join. Will roll out canary after CI.
emma: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Ping when backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
